title: 第9章 经验值：56%（萌新求收藏！求追读！）
slug: 万界词条从基因锁词条开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

小型无线电机器发出嗡嗡声，一道声音从中响起。

“注意！这个试炼世界的怪物具有传染性！只要被抓到或者咬伤，亦或者眼睛嘴巴接触到这些怪物的血液，都会被感染！”

“感染时间大约为半个小时，一旦发现有人受伤，立刻将其击杀或者驱逐！”

“有电台的人立刻来我这里汇合，这个试炼世界，有两个内城来的大人物，他们随手漏一点东西，都够你们享用不尽的！”

话音落下，罗兰便看到小型无线电机器的屏幕上多出了一个坐标和绿色亮点。

亮点闪烁不定，罗兰脑海中回忆自己学习过的知识，目光一闪：“这人所在的地方，距离我并不近，大约有一百里左右。”

“这样一来，我就不会和这些人碰到了，如此也好。”

罗兰深深吸了一口气。

内城，和聚集地比起来是一个天上一个地下，内城来的大人物，手里面的确有很多好东西，甚至属性都比他们要强很多！

不过，罗兰可没有兴趣接触他们。

他父母，就是被内城人当做肉盾，最终因此死亡。

只是他一直不知道父母是被谁害死的，问了王叔，王叔也不清楚。

“这两个内城的人，肯定要详细探索这个试炼世界，不过，只要不是运气很好，那就很难发现丧尸脑子里的晶核。”

罗兰心中暗暗猜测了一番，旋即放下这些念头，继续修炼。

直到天色变黑，月色降临，罗兰这才停下动作。

“呼！”

他长长吐出一口浊气，气息悠长，只觉得自己五脏六腑中的杂质，都在这一口气中被吐了出去，身体前所未有的清爽！

“看看经验值到了多少。”

念头微动，罗兰

他目光落在了自己的经验值上。

经验值：35%

“不错！将近12小时的修炼，竟然让我增加了5%的经验值！”

看着自己的经验值，罗兰心中一喜。

“没想到，基本呼吸法一层入门之后，配合花费源能增快修炼的效果，居然这么好！”

不过罗兰也知道，这也和他开启过一阶基因锁有关！

开启一阶基因锁之后，那种完全凌驾于1级战士的力量和技巧，对罗兰的影响很大！

虽然现在一阶基因锁的持续时间早就结束了，但是开启一阶基因锁时的感觉，还残留在罗兰心中。

“这几天，我专心养伤，然后不停修炼基本呼吸法，争取让经验值来一波大提升！”

罗兰深深吸气，活动了一下身体，拿出自己在房间中收集到的鸡肉味火腿肠吃了起来。

“终于，吃到人该吃的东西了！”

感受着和上一世基本没有什么区别的火腿肠味道，罗兰心中泪流满面。

Page (1/3)

The small radio machine hummed and a voice sounded from it.

"Attention! The monsters in this trial world are contagious! As long as you are caught or bitten, or your eyes and mouth come into contact with the blood of these monsters, you will be infected!"

"The infection time is about half an hour. Once someone is found injured, kill or expel them immediately!"

"People from the radio station will join me immediately. In this trial world, there are two big shots from the inner city. If they leak anything, it will be enough for you to enjoy!"

As soon as he finished speaking, Roland saw an additional coordinate and green bright spot on the screen of the small radio machine.

The bright spots flickered, and Roland recalled the knowledge he had learned in his mind, and his eyes flashed: "The place where this person is is not close to me, about a hundred miles away."

"This way, I won't run into these people, that's fine."

Roland took a deep breath.

Compared with the gathering place, the inner city is like heaven and earth. The big shots from the inner city do have a lot of good things in their hands, and their attributes are even much stronger than them!

However, Roland had no interest in contacting them.

His parents were used as human shields by the people in the inner city and eventually died as a result.

It's just that he never knew who killed his parents. When he asked Uncle Wang, he didn't know either.

"These two people from the inner city will definitely explore this trial world in detail. However, unless you are very lucky, it will be difficult to find the crystal core in the zombie's brain."

Roland secretly made some guesses in his mind, then put these thoughts aside and continued practicing.

Roland didn't stop until the sky turned dark and the moonlight came.

"Phew!"

He exhaled a long breath of turbid air. He felt that all the impurities in his internal organs were exhaled in this breath, and his body felt refreshed as never before!

"Look at how much experience the value has reached."

Thoughts are moving, Roland

His eyes fell on his experience points.

Experience value: 35%

"Not bad! Nearly 12 hours of practice actually increased my experience points by 5%!"

Looking at his experience points, Roland felt happy.

"I didn't expect that after getting started with the basic breathing method, combined with spending energy to speed up the practice, the effect would be so good!"

But Roland also knew that this was also related to the fact that he had opened the first-level gene lock!

After turning on the first-level gene lock, the power and skills that completely surpassed the first-level warriors had a great impact on Roland!

Although the duration of the first-level gene lock has ended long ago, the feeling when the first-level gene lock was turned on still remains in Roland's heart.

"In the past few days, I have been concentrating on recovering from my injuries, and then I have been practicing basic breathing techniques to try to get a big increase in experience points!"

Roland took a deep breath, moved his body, took out the chicken-flavored ham sausages he collected in the room and ate them.

“Finally, I’m eating what a person should eat!”

Feeling the taste of ham that was basically the same as in the previous life, Roland burst into tears.
